highlights: Full-Stack Security & Reliability Remediation (5 Waves): Enforced scoped axw_svc_* service-token RBAC and interactive-route exclusions, SSRF/origin/proxy guards across web APIs, MCP tools, and Vigilante scanners, atomic state/lockout/revocation persistence, secret redaction (WAN knock sequences, metadata sync tokens, harvester salts, DDNS custom URLs), LogsQL filter prepending before pipes, and HTTP 429/400/401 validation ordering.

Daemon, eBPF, Compilers & Web Console Stability: Hardened QEMU/LXC allowlists, ZFSBootMenu/Btrfs/GRUB rollback guards, ClassID pending-cleanup reservations, bounded [-4095, 0] LSM eBPF returns, VyOS ! negation & custom BPF-token schema validation, topology peer targeted patching, Zod render/useMemo crash & XSS protections, and untouched-field preservation on save.

CI, ISO & Packaging Hardening: Fixed unified Debian 13 ISO size under the 1.9 GiB GitHub Release asset limit, ensured world-readable ISO output permissions under sudo, fixed Alpine checksum loop exit codes in Compute Checksums, and hardened extract_deb() tar-slip/archive validation.

Edge-to-Central-Analytics Telemetry Offload: Added unified observability.offload in system.yaml alongside decoupled netflow.mode (collector | exporter | both) and netflow.nodeId in netflow.yaml, non-blocking Prometheus Remote-Write (snappy protobuf + optional /metrics), VictoriaLogs NDJSON/gzip shipping (native NETLINK_NETFILTER NFLOG token-bucket guard defaulting to 50/s, journald, Suricata EVE, CrowdSec, Kea DHCP, and opt-in Unbound query logs), bounded RAM ring buffer + opt-in zstd disk spool, per-target eBPF/conntrack delta accounting (GetAllFlowCounters(16384)), ingress_ifindex eBPF tracking, IPFIX Enterprise PEN 62999 Options Templates 258/259, multi-node ClickHouse node: FQL filtering, SD-WAN ping RTT/jitter/loss metrics, opt-in remoteEdgeMitigation with protectedCidrs, and unprivileged axonwalld --mode=collector.

Hardened WAN Headscale Invite Access & Optional Stateful Port Knocking: Added dedicated SNI/Host-pinned HAProxy frontend (fe_headscale_wan_invite) with strict /invite/*, static asset, and preview/redeem path allowlist + http-request silent-drop keeping /login, /lobby, /vpn, /admin, and /metrics blocked from WAN; dynamic headscale_wan_window_ports nftables set automatically opened only while unexpired pending invites exist (or manually armed) and closed immediately on redeem/revoke/expiry via HeadscaleWanGateManager; optional kernel UDP/TCP stateful port knocking (headscale_knock_s* -> headscale_knock_allow_v4/v6), optional scrypt-hashed 6-digit out-of-band PIN with 5-attempt auto-revocation, optional allowedCidrs, and single-page QR + tailscale up setup on /invite/[token].

Scoped Service Tokens, Multi-Node Console, 29-Tool MCP & K3s Analytics Stack: Added scrypt-hashed axw_svc_* Bearer tokens (/api/v1/system/service-tokens*), /reporting/observability and /reporting/logs views, live VictoriaMetrics charts & multi-node selectors across /reporting/{health,insight,netflow} and /fleet, Satellite TELEMETRY_REPORT/EDGE_FLOW_BATCH bridging, 2 new MCP resources (18 total) & 4 new MCP tools (29 total: mcp_query_metrics, mcp_query_logs, mcp_query_historical_flows, mcp_trigger_edge_mitigation), unprivileged multi-arch container images (Dockerfile.axonwalld, Dockerfile.controller, containers.yml), and the deploy/k8s/helm/axonwall-analytics Helm chart (homelab/standard/enterprise profiles on axonwall-zfs-local).

Commit-Confirm & Anti-Lockout Hardening: Removed localhost /v1/confirm auto-confirm bypasses and pre-apply /etc/axonwall/* disk writes across Web Console interface assignments, DesiredState apply pipelines, and WireGuard peer registration; added live+static overlapping subnet guards and restricted default gateway emission to WAN.

Live Kernel Network Rollback (net_rollback.go): Added live IPv4/route/link snapshot and rollback with ECMP multipath nexthop restoration, virtual/overlay NIC exclusion (tailscale*, wg*, veth*, tap*, cni*, flannel*, cilium*, br-*), non-releasing dhcpcd -x / rebind, promote_secondaries=1, and resilient executeRollback even when last-known-good.nft is empty or nft -f fails.

Boot, SD-WAN, Topology & Systemd Reliability: Fixed --boot-apply startup ordering for expired/live pending-confirm bundles, prober.go cancellation race before evaluateFailover(), topology.go premature peer auto-confirm, getDesiredStateInternal() read-clobber protection, controlSystemService critical-unit stop guards, and RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes on axonwalld/headscale/axonwall-ui systemd units.

Lean Router/NGFW Core Default (5 Core Roles + 42 Opt-In Extension Plugins = 47 Manifests): Standard axonwall installs boot cleanly with core-firewall active (nftables, WireGuard, Kea DHCP, Unbound DNS) while keeping IDS/IPS (suricata-ids, crowdsec-bouncer), FRRouting, OpenVPN, strongSwan, OpenLDAP/SSSD (directory-ldap), Enterprise SSO, High Availability, ai-copilot, docs-portal, and Zsh/Neovim Workstation opt-in with validated /bin/bash & local POSIX UserManager fallback. Minimal edition starts with all 5 Core Roles disabled.

4 Curated Starter Packs Across Web UI, CLI, Installer & Cloud-Init: Install and enable enterprise-ngfw, remote-access-vpn, operator-diagnostics, or ai-observability in one click (/system/plugins with category filter pills & impact/dependency confirmation modal), via Ink TUI [p], bare-metal installer [P] (starter-packs.seed with daemon-ready firstboot), Cloud-Init (starter_packs:), or axonwallctl plugin pack install [--offline-config-only] (resolving full transitive dependency closure).

Opt-In AI Copilot (/ai) & CSP-Hardened Offline Docs Portal (/docs): Extracted Eluvix AI Copilot into ai-copilot and built a standalone ~1.1 MB RSA-4096 detached SHA-256 signature verified offline documentation tarball for docs-portal (scripts/build-docs-bundle.sh, strict /api/docs-bundle Content-Security-Policy) with transparent fallback to https://axonwall.com/docs.

Air-Gapped Offline Plugin Cache & Selective Dependency Closure: Hardened scripts/build-plugins-bundle.sh (isolated empty dpkg status + package/provides/depends metadata), fail-closed SHA-256 + symlink verification and selective dependency closure in axonwalld (/var/lib/axonwall/plugin-cache/<os>/), and axonwallctl plugin cache-status.

Fail-Closed Control Plane, Safe Uninstall & v0.15.x Upgrade Preservation: Enforced fail-closed plugin checks across axonwalld, axonwall-controller (MCP/Fleet + dormant headscale ZTP gating), getOidcConfig, and 32+ Web Console Server Actions; added protectedCoreOSPackages uninstall guards, DesiredState dependency cleanup on uninstall, non-blocking batched async systemctl show supervision (/system/services), runtime OpenLDAP bootstrap wiring, and idempotent v0.15.x upgrade preservation synced to state.json.

Multi-Protocol Flow Collector, Transport Hardening & Replication (netflow-collector, /etc/axonwall/netflow.yaml): Added NetFlow v5, NetFlow v9, IPFIX (RFC 7011 over UDP, TCP & TLS 1.3 / optional mTLS), and sFlow v5 decoding with Linux SO_REUSEPORT multi-worker scaling and a UDP fan-out replicator supporting optional raw-socket source-IP spoofing (CAP_NET_RAW).

Dual-Stack eBPF Self-Exporter & Kernel NPM Telemetry (Templates 256 IPv4 / 257 IPv6): Emits dual-stack IPFIX records enriched with NAT/CGNAT IEs 225-228 and Linux NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG kernel TCP RTT & retransmit NPM telemetry.

Pure-Go Enrichment Pipeline (netflow_mmdb.go, netflow_enrich.go): Implemented a zero-CGO MaxMind .mmdb v2 reader with scheduled/on-demand HTTPS GeoLite2/DB-IP updates (/api/v1/netflow/geoip/update), live FRR BGP RIB longest-prefix-match AS-Path/Next-Hop, live K3s Pod/Namespace/Service attribution, Linux conntrack NAT/CGNAT mapping, reverse DNS, SNMP ifAlias, and Suricata/CrowdSec/Threat-Intel tagging.

Persisted 1m/5m/1h Zstd Rollups, ClickHouse SQL Pushdown & Prometheus (/api/v1/netflow/metrics): Multi-tier historical rollup merging across [startMs, endMs], parameterized FQL-to-ClickHouse SQL pushdown, and native OpenMetrics/Prometheus text exposition.

Session Stitching, 95th-Pct Reports, Adaptive 7d x 24h Baselines & Fleet Federation: Added bidirectional biflow session stitching, Source x Dest & Port x Time heatmaps, geo arcs, 95th/99th-percentile CSV/Markdown/JSON capacity reports with scheduled snapshots, 168-slot EWMA/Z-score & first-seen pair baselines, and federated queries across topology.peers.

NetFlow Analytics Studio UI, API & CLI (/reporting/netflow, axonwallctl netflow): 5-tab Studio with FqlInputBar autocomplete, FlowExplorerTab brush-zoom + sessions, FlowHeatmapsPanel, offline SVG GeoTrafficMap, ReportsPanel, LiveTailTab SSE, ExportersTemplatesTab, AlertsAnomaliesTab, PipelineConfigTab, 1-click XDP/PCAP/Alias/Topology pivots, 11 secret-redacted /api/v1/netflow/* endpoints, and axonwallctl netflow status|query|fleet-query|report.

Interactive Fabric Topology Studio (topology-studio, /topology, /etc/axonwall/topology.yaml): Browser-native @xyflow/react multi-host, WAN, K3s, and cable fabric topology editor (TopologyStudioWorkspace) with inspector, path tracer, cable cut sheet, staged diff, scenario manager, and Triad sync drawers, strict Green/Yellow/Red health probes (/api/v1/topology/probe), WAN-excluded lldpd, and phased transactional apply.

NetBox v4 DCIM/IPAM & LibreNMS Discovery Triad (netbox, librenms, /services/netbox, /services/librenms, services.yaml): Turnkey K3s-native deployment and idempotent inventory sync for NetBox v4 and LibreNMS (SNMPv2c/v3, LLDP/CDP/FDB discovery, optical DOM, alert webhooks) with OpenLDAP SSO service accounts (svc-netbox, svc-librenms), Triad cross-sync (/api/v1/services/{netbox,librenms}/*), and expanded 14-domain / 26-to-27 plugin catalog.

Browser K9s Live Explorer (/k3s/explorer, /v1/k3s/* & /api/k3s/logs/stream): Browser-native K9s workbench with keyboard command navigation (:po, :svc, :ing, :pulse, :topo), Cluster Pulse Recharts visualizations, interactive SVG Ingress-to-PVC Topology Map, live SSE logs, container exec, YAML dry-run edit, admin Secret decode, and default CLI k9s (v0.51.0).

Daemons, eBPF & Satellite: Hardened netdev/ZFS/K3s/Virt engines, bundle validation, and Threat-LLM Harvester eBPF; added standby interface fencing, fixed nftables netlink opcodes, and improved cloud-init parsing.

Vigilante Base Domain & Module Endpoint URLs: Configure the Vigilante base domain directly in /vigilante/modules and view/launch per-module HTTPS endpoints (soc.<domain>, wazuh.<domain>, opensearch.<domain>, etc.). Updated axonwalld bundle validation to permit in-house Vigilante modular SOC HelmCharts alongside Cilium.
